(function () {
  var UC_DATA = {
    'museum-life-science': {
      title: 'Real Time Planet Exploration at Full Tilt',
      institution: 'Museum of Life & Science',
      location: 'Durham, North Carolina',
      img: '/assets/images/use-cases/mols_tiltatable.webp',
      imgAlt: 'A visitor uses a tilt table with live OpenSpace visuals at the Museum of Life & Science',

      tags: ['Interactive exhibit', 'Real-time data', 'Public museum']
    },
    'b612': {

      body: '"Ed Lu wants to save Earth from killer asteroids." OpenSpace\'s capability to incorporate new data as it emerges allows these scientists and engineers to contextualize and visualize current data developed from their Asteroid Discovery Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) platform.',
      tags: ['Scientific research', 'Planetary defense', 'Live data']
    },
    'lawrence': {
      title: 'OpenSpace Gives Visitors Control of the Planetarium Dome',
      institution: 'The Lawrence Hall of Science',
      location: 'Berkeley, California',
      img: '../../assets/images/use-cases/Lawrence-9.7..23-0013.webp',
      imgAlt: 'Visitors at the Lawrence Hall of Science piloting the planetarium dome with OpenSpace',
      body: 'OpenSpace began by focusing on enabling live presentations by professionals in planetarium domes. Now a new program at The Lawrence invites anyone to become "Planetarium Pilots." Voice-overs explain the space science behind the visuals as visitors fly around space.',
      tags: ['Planetarium', 'Public engagement', 'Visitor-led exploration']
    },
    'houston': {
      title: 'Gaming with OpenSpace',
      institution: 'Houston Museum of Natural Science',
      location: 'Houston, Texas',
      img: '../../assets/images/use-cases/Houston.webp',
      imgAlt: 'Visitors at the Houston Museum of Natural Science playing an OpenSpace-based space science game',
      body: 'In Texas, OpenSpace videos and photos form the backbone of HMNS\'s space science game lab. The lab has a family focus, fostering increased social engagement through the room\'s fifteen-plus stations and seating. In addition to families, the lab attracts visitors of all ages looking for a quiet space of collaborative learning. For kids and by kids — high school interns programmed the games using content they captured themselves within OpenSpace.',
      tags: ['K–12 education', 'Games', 'Family learning']
    },
    'towson': {
      title: 'OpenSpace Takes Audiences from Sunrise to Sunset',
      institution: 'The Towson University Planetarium',
      location: 'Baltimore County, Maryland',
      img: '/assets/images/use-cases/towson.webp',
      imgAlt: 'A view of Earth from space as shown in OpenSpace',
      body: 'What do kids from Title One schools, scout troops, older adults with dementia and their caregivers, and the state Higher Education Commission all have in common? These are all audiences at Towson University\'s planetarium. The planetarium director chooses to use OpenSpace for talks and shows, as it "gives a better viewing experience and uses real data." The growth of OpenSpace users increases growth in both the software and in new content areas, creating a more powerful system over time.',
      tags: ['Diverse audiences', 'Planetarium', 'University']
    },
    'asu': {
      title: 'Passers-By Fly High in OpenSpace',
      institution: 'The Marston Exploration Theater at Arizona State University',
      location: 'Tempe, Arizona',
      img: '../../assets/images/use-cases/Color%20Corrected%20Arizona%20State%20Photo.webp',
      imgAlt: 'Visitors piloting the Interactive Immersive Educational Experience display at ASU',
      body: 'In the queueing area for ASU\'s Exploration Theater, visitors can do more than watch a tour of the universe — they pilot it. The Interactive Immersive Educational Experience (I2E2) is a panoramic display controlled by the visitor who wants to explore space and Earth in their own way, with room for 20 other students or family members. This implementation makes it easy for untrained pilots to fly, hover, and dive into the planetary or geological body of their choosing.',
      tags: ['Interactive kiosk', 'Panoramic display', 'University']
    },
    'wow-room': {
      title: 'Step Into the Wow Room',
      institution: 'Goddard\'s Community Coordinated Modelling Center',
      location: 'Greenbelt, Maryland',
      img: '../../assets/images/use-cases/Wow%20room%20Color%20Corrected.webp',
      imgAlt: 'Visitors seated in the Wow Room at NASA Goddard CCMC watching an OpenSpace visualization on a curved screen',
      body: 'The Community Coordinated Modelling Center (CCMC) uses OpenSpace in their "Wow Room," a space at the Center for engaging high-profile guests — whether they are national policy makers or senior NASA leadership. Four projectors and a curved screen create an immersive experience that helps make the case for the importance of supporting space and Earth science research.',
      tags: ['Policy outreach', 'Immersive display', 'NASA']
    },
    'rachel-smith': {
      title: 'To Infinity and Beyond: OpenSpace as a Powerful Outreach Tool',
      institution: 'Dr. Rachel Smith — Super User',
      location: 'Raleigh, North Carolina',
      img: '../../assets/images/use-cases/Rachel%20talk.webp',
      imgAlt: 'Dr. Rachel Smith giving a presentation with OpenSpace visualizations',
      body: 'Dr. Rachel Smith uses OpenSpace in research, teaching, and museum exhibitions. OpenSpace\'s data-rich visualizations enable Dr. Smith\'s compelling outreach to a wide variety of audiences including retirement communities, science conferences, and public policy groups.',
      tags: ['Super User', 'Research', 'Public outreach']
    },
    'hyperwall': {
      title: 'Talking Peer-to-Peer',
      institution: 'The NASA Hyperwall',
      location: 'Scientific conferences nationwide',
      img: '../../assets/images/use-cases/Rachel%20from%20conference.webp',
      imgAlt: 'A scientist presenting OpenSpace data visualizations at a conference',
      body: 'Scientists regularly share their work using OpenSpace on the NASA Hyperwall at conferences — including the Geological Society of America, American Geophysical Union, and American Astronomical Society. OpenSpace\'s impressive visualizations and the ability to interact with those visualizations supports in-depth peer discussions in conference settings.',
      tags: ['Scientific conferences', 'NASA Hyperwall', 'Peer discussion']
    },
    
  };

  var modal     = document.getElementById('ucModal');
  var modalImg  = modal.querySelector('.uc-modal-img');
  var modalMeta = modal.querySelector('.uc-modal-meta');
  var modalTitle= modal.querySelector('.uc-modal-title');
  var modalBody = modal.querySelector('.uc-modal-body');
  var modalTags = modal.querySelector('.uc-modal-tags');
  var closeBtn  = modal.querySelector('.uc-modal-close');
  var backdrop  = modal.querySelector('.uc-modal-backdrop');
  var lastFocused = null;

  function openModal(id) {
    var d = UC_DATA[id];
    if (!d) return;
    modalImg.src       = d.img;
    modalImg.alt       = d.imgAlt || d.title;
    var meta = d.institution + (d.location ? ' · ' + d.location : '');
    modalMeta.textContent  = meta;
    modalTitle.textContent = d.title;
    modalBody.textContent  = d.body;
    modalTags.innerHTML = d.tags.map(function (t) {
      return '<span class="uc-modal-tag">' + t + '</span>';
    }).join('');
    modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    modal.classList.add('is-open');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    closeBtn.focus();
  }

  function closeModal() {
    modal.classList.remove('is-open');
    modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    if (lastFocused) lastFocused.focus();
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('.uc-card').forEach(function (card) {
    card.addEventListener('click', function () {
      lastFocused = card;
      openModal(card.dataset.case);
    });
    card.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        lastFocused = card;
        openModal(card.dataset.case);
      }
    });
  });

  closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
  backdrop.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && modal.classList.contains('is-open')) closeModal();
  });
})();
</script>
